subject: design/implement-now-e2e-tasks
statement: The executor gains **one pre-claim resolution stage and two admission stages**, all inside the existing Worker and Dispatcher shape and behind the unchanged frontier and claim path. Before claim, the frontier walk follows the plan-task marker every projected item already carries back to the frozen plan, reads the governing-document field the plan class already requires of every plan, and — where that names an `approved`, well-formed `e2e-design/v1` document — recovers the task's slot by re-running the same closed rule that authored the plan, resolving a task to exactly one scenario, to the harness slot, or to nothing (`design-brainstorm:implement-now-tech-design-2#D-3`, `#ALT-1`). The resolved basis reaches the worker as a **read-only artifact outside the publishing worktree**, named by the charter's protocol but never folded into it — data, structurally, not instruction (`#D-4`, `#ALT-5`). The authored test then faces two admissions in different positions, each placed where its consequence can actually bind: a **labelled perturbation battery before the proposal is ever opened**, so a check that cannot hold its verdict is never published and therefore never enters required CI or the self-heal loop (`#D-6`, `#ALT-11`, as refined at review by `#D-9`); and, once a proposal is genuinely green, a **scope diff and broken-subject falsification** that together establish the test tests and the feature was not bent to satisfy it (`#D-5`, `#ALT-8`).
